articles.title: The Mine That Filled the Road
articles.summary: A mine owner rewards the manager for every cart removed; soon the road is full of ore while the furnace receives no more copper.
articles.summaryZh: 矿主按运出的车数奖励管事，山路很快堆满矿石，熔炉却没有得到更多铜。
storyParagraphs: The copper-mine owner lived in the city and inspected the site only once a month. To encourage production, he paid the manager a bonus for every cart brought down. The manager needed to keep workers employed and wanted his own share, so he posted a target at the entrance: sixty carts each day.

For several months, cart totals rose. Then the richest seam narrowed, and sorting ore slowed the work. The manager ordered low-grade rock loaded as well. Easy stone near safety supports was also removed. The ledger filled with impressive numbers, but the smelter received no more copper and waste blocked the road.

The owner accused the manager of deception. The manager produced the bonus rule: every recorded cart had truly left the mine. He had completed the work for which he was paid. The owner wanted usable copper and safe tunnels but had observed and rewarded only the easiest thing to count.

The new agreement no longer depended on carts alone. Bonuses also used smelter output, sampled ore quality, and support records, while an independent surveyor visited the mine. Workers did not carry all losses caused by changing copper prices, but the manager could no longer profit from waste alone.
The cart board remained at the entrance. At month's end, the manager added the sampled copper content beside 'sixty carts'.
storyParagraphsZh: 铜矿主常年住在城里，只能每月看一次矿场账。为了让管事多出矿，他规定每运下一车便发奖金。管事需要留住工人，也想拿到自己的分成，于是把目标写在矿口：每天六十车。
头几个月，车数不断上升。后来富矿层变窄，挑选矿石会拖慢速度。管事便让工人把低含量石头也装车，安全支柱旁容易开采的岩块也被挖走。账上全是好看的数字，冶炼厂收到的铜却没有增加，山路还被废石堵住。
矿主责问管事为何欺骗自己。管事拿出奖金规则：每一车都真实离开矿口，他完成了被付钱去完成的事。矿主想要的是可用铜和安全矿道，却只观察、奖励了最容易数的车。
新约定不再只看车数。奖金同时参考冶炼产出、矿石抽检和支柱记录，矿主也请独立测量员定期进矿。工人不必承担矿价波动造成的全部损失，管事则不能靠废石独自获利。
月底，矿口仍挂着计车木板。管事在“六十车”旁边添上了每车抽检后的铜量。
explanationParagraphs: A principal-agent problem arises when a principal delegates work to an agent whose interests are not perfectly aligned and whose information or actions cannot be fully observed. Contracts, monitoring, governance, reputation, and risk sharing can help, but narrow metrics invite goal substitution, while overly strong incentives may transfer uncontrollable risk unfairly.
explanationParagraphsZh: 委托代理问题发生在委托人把工作交给代理人，双方利益并不完全一致，而代理人的信息或行动又难以完整观察。合同、监督、治理、声誉与风险分担可以缓解，但狭窄指标会诱发替代目标，过强激励也可能把不可控风险错误转给代理人。

articles.title: The Gear No One Put on the Table
articles.summary: Everyone in the machine shop sees the cracked tooth, but no one wants to be first to place it before the master.
articles.summaryZh: 机坊里每个人都见过那枚裂齿，却没有人愿意成为第一个把它放到师傅面前的人。
storyParagraphs: The master of the clock-machine shop was known for severity. An apprentice who asked what he considered an easy question was mocked for 'leaving the brain at home'. When one admitted reversing a spring, the master made him redo the work at the doorway for three days. Finished pieces looked increasingly orderly, while questions disappeared.

During a rush order for a sluice mechanism, three apprentices separately saw a fine crack on the same gear. The first feared delaying delivery. The second assumed someone earlier had checked it. The third did not want public ridicule. The gear entered the machine, broke during testing, and stopped the entire assembly for two days.

The master first demanded to know who had known. No one answered. A senior apprentice placed the broken tooth on the table and said the problem was not that nobody had seen it. Everyone could predict what would happen after speaking.

The shop began reserving time before work for questions, damaged parts, and unfinished judgements. No one could be punished merely for reporting, though concealment, careless work, and repeated mistakes still had consequences. When someone first placed a miscut shaft on the table, the master asked what it would affect before assigning responsibility for rework.
Before the next batch was packed, a new apprentice pushed one gear into the centre. The room fell quiet for a moment, then three people leaned over the crack.
storyParagraphsZh: 钟机坊的师傅以严厉闻名。学徒若问了他认为简单的问题，便会被当众叫作“没带脑子”。一次，有人承认装反弹簧，师傅罚他在门口重做三日。从那以后，桌面上的成品越来越整齐，疑问却消失了。
赶制水闸机轮时，三名学徒分别看见同一枚齿轮边缘有细裂。第一个怕耽误交货，第二个以为前面的人已经检查，第三个不愿再被嘲笑。齿轮最终装进机器，在试转中断裂，整套机轮停了两天。
师傅最初追问谁早就知道。没人开口。老学徒把那枚裂齿放到桌上，说问题并不是无人看见，而是每个人都能预料说出来以后会发生什么。
此后，开工前先留一刻钟放置疑问、坏件和未完成判断。师傅不能因报告本身处罚人，但隐瞒、敷衍和重复失误仍须追查。第一次有人放上磨偏的轴时，师傅先问它会影响哪里，再决定返工责任。
下一批齿轮尚未装箱，一名新学徒把其中一枚推到桌中央。屋里安静了一下，随后三个人同时凑近裂纹。
explanationParagraphs: Psychological safety is a shared belief that interpersonal risks such as questions, help-seeking, disagreement, and admitting mistakes will not predictably bring humiliation or punishment. It helps problems surface early but does not mean lower standards, comfort, or freedom from accountability. What leaders actually do after someone speaks determines whether invitations are credible.
explanationParagraphsZh: 心理安全感是团队共同相信，提问、求助、异议和承认错误等人际冒险不会可预期地换来羞辱或惩罚。它支持更早暴露问题，却不等于降低标准、避免冲突或免于问责。领导对发言后的真实回应决定邀请是否可信。

articles.title: The Workshop That Perfected Yesterday
articles.titleZh: 把昨天做到完美的作坊
articles.summary: A tailoring shop makes heavy wool coats faster each year while customers outside begin asking for something else.
articles.summaryZh: 裁衣坊把厚呢外套做得越来越快，顾客却已经开始在门外询问另一种衣服。
storyParagraphs: Ever-Winter Tailors excelled at heavy wool coats. Twelve production steps ran to the minute, and fabric waste fell every year. Owner Cen Mu invested each profit in more of the same cutting tables and storage, believing the business could not leave if coats became faster and cheaper to make.

After several warm winters, dockworkers began asking for light rainwear. Clerks wrote the requests on the backs of orders, but Cen Mu treated them as a passing fashion and expanded the wool stock. By the following spring, finished coats filled the warehouse while old customers bought breathable rainwear from another city.

A young cutter made a small trial from waterproof cloth and asked dockworkers to wear it for a month. The first version trapped heat, the second leaked at the seams, and the third received orders. Cen Mu did not dismantle every old machine. He kept the winter line, converted one group of tables for the new cloth, and signed a small short-term contract with another supplier.

He began reviewing customer notes weekly, reserved money for trials, and trained experienced cutters to seal seams. One later product still failed. The shop closed that small line without stopping all change and retained the technique it had learned.
When the next warm winter arrived, the warehouse still held wool, but no longer held only wool. Cen Mu personally removed the old words 'Winter Coats Only' from the door.
storyParagraphsZh: 永冬裁衣坊最擅长厚呢外套。十二道工序被排得分秒不差，布料损耗也一年比一年少。老板岑牧把利润继续投入同样的剪床和仓库，深信只要做得更快、更便宜，生意便不会离开。
连续几个暖冬后，码头工开始询问轻便防雨衣。店员把这些问题记在订单背面，岑牧却把它们当作短暂时尚，继续扩大厚呢库存。第二年春天，仓库堆满成衣，老客户却转向能挡雨又不闷热的外城产品。
年轻裁工拿几块防水布做了小批试衣，请码头工连续穿一月。第一版不透气，第二版接缝漏水，第三版才得到订单。岑牧没有立刻拆掉全部旧设备，而是保留冬衣线，把一组剪床改成新布专用，并与新的布商签小额短约。
随后，他把店员的顾客记录改成每周查看，给试做留出预算，也训练老裁工处理胶合接缝。一次新产品仍然失败，作坊没有因此停下所有改变，而是关闭那条小线并保留学到的工艺。
下一次暖冬到来时，仓库里仍有厚呢，却不再只有厚呢。岑牧亲手擦掉门口“只做冬衣”的旧字。
explanationParagraphs: Dynamic capabilities are higher-order abilities to sense environmental change, seize selected opportunities, and reconfigure resources, processes, and competences. They differ from ordinary capabilities that perform current work efficiently. Sensing, experimentation, and transformation require investment and judgement, remain shaped by existing assets and paths, and do not guarantee every change will succeed.
explanationParagraphsZh: 动态能力是组织感知环境变化、抓住选定机会，并重组资源、流程与能力的高阶能力。它不同于把现有工作高效完成的普通能力。感知、试验和转型需要投入与判断，也受既有资产和路径限制，不能保证每次改变都成功。

articles.title: The Soap That Promised Everything
articles.summary: A soapmaker fills the wrapper with everyone's wishes until no one knows what the soap is actually for.
articles.summaryZh: 肥皂匠在包装上写满所有人的愿望，最后谁也不知道这块肥皂究竟适合什么。
storyParagraphs: Soapmaker Qiao Lan wanted her new bar to serve the entire city. Its wrapper promised the whitest wash, finest scent, gentlest touch, longest use, and lowest price. To pursue all of them, she added expensive fragrance, cut the bars small, and reduced the lye needed for heavy dirt. The shelf carried many claims and few repeat buyers.

Qiao Lan went to the market. Dockworkers complained about salt stains. Inns cared about the cost of large-volume use. Families with children valued gentleness. People buying the same category were trying to solve different problems, and her small workshop could not serve every group equally well.

She chose dock soap first because nearby fleets purchased regularly and the workshop already knew how to remove salt residue. The new bar no longer claimed to be most fragrant or most gentle. It promised to lift salt in cold water and last through a voyage.

Cheaper inn soap and more fragrant household soap remained on the shelf. Qiao Lan's product was not best for everyone, but people washing sea salt could quickly see why to choose it. After a fleet trial showed that the bar sat in water, she changed its shape.
When replacing the wrapper, Qiao Lan cut away six old promises and left one line: 'For the salt the sea wind leaves behind.'
storyParagraphsZh: 肥皂匠乔岚想把新作卖给全城。她在包装上写：洗得最白、气味最香、最温和、最耐用、价格最低。为了同时做到这些，肥皂加入许多香油，切得很小，又减少能去重污的碱。货架上的字很多，回购的人很少。
乔岚到市场观察。码头工抱怨盐渍难洗，旅店在意大批使用的成本，有孩子的家庭更看重温和。三群人买同一件东西时，真正要解决的问题并不相同，也不是每群都值得她用有限作坊同时服务。
她选择先做码头用皂，因为附近船队稳定采购，而作坊已有处理盐垢的技术。新皂不再承诺最香或最温和，只强调冷水中也能洗掉盐渍，而且一块能用完整个航程。
货架上仍有更便宜的旅店皂，也有气味更好的家用皂。乔岚的新作不是对所有人最好，却让需要洗盐渍的人很快知道为什么要选它。船队试用后提出皂盒容易积水，她又修改了形状。
换包装那天，乔岚把旧纸上六句承诺剪掉，只留下“给海风留下的盐”。
explanationParagraphs: Segmentation identifies groups with different needs, behaviours, or likely responses; targeting chooses whom to serve; positioning defines a credible and distinctive value relative to alternatives. Together they connect market understanding to resource allocation. Segments remain revisable models and require attention to reachability, economics, stereotyping, privacy, and exclusion.
explanationParagraphsZh: 细分识别需求、行为或反应不同的群体；目标选择决定优先服务谁；定位则相对替代品说明可信而独特的价值。三者把市场理解连接到资源配置。细分只是可修订模型，还需检查可触达性、经济性、刻板印象、隐私与排斥。

articles.title: Two Jars with Hidden Honey
articles.titleZh: 两罐看不见内部的蜂蜜
articles.summary: Two sellers claim their sealed jars contain pure honey, but only one keeps the promise alive through winter.
articles.summaryZh: 两个卖家都说陶罐里是纯蜜，只有一个愿意让承诺在冬天继续生效。
storyParagraphs: Two sealed honey jars at the market looked identical. An old beekeeper and a new trader each said his honey contained no sugar water. Customers could not see inside or taste the whole jar. Louder assurances did not reveal which seller was reliable.

The beekeeper tied a contract around the lid. If the honey remained watery in winter or a test found added sugar, he would buy it back at full price and provide another jar. He kept his own hives, and pure honey was unlikely to trigger the promise, so it cost him little to offer.

The trader considered attaching the same paper, then shortened his guarantee to three days. The more diluted honey he sold, the more jars he would have to buy back in winter. Matching the beekeeper's promise could consume all his immediate profit.

Customers therefore paid somewhat more for the beekeeper's jars. The contract did not make honey pure, and a seal could still be forged, but the two sellers faced different costs in maintaining the promise. The market later added common testing rather than relying on paper reputation alone.
After the first winter frost, the beekeeper returned with his scales. He checked the old contracts from the previous season before setting out new jars.
storyParagraphsZh: 集市上有两罐封好的蜂蜜，外表一模一样。老蜂农与新商贩都说自己的蜜没有掺糖水。顾客看不见罐内，也无法当场尝遍整罐，单靠更响亮的保证分不出谁可信。
老蜂农在罐口系上一张契纸：若入冬后蜂蜜仍稀得像水，或验出掺糖，原价买回并另赔一罐。他常年养蜂，纯蜜出现这种问题的机会很小，这项承诺对他并不昂贵。
新商贩也想系同样的纸。他算过以后却缩短为三日，因为掺水蜜卖出越多，冬天需要买回的罐子越多。若照抄老蜂农的承诺，他眼前赚的钱可能全用来赔付。
顾客因此愿意为老蜂农多付一些。契纸没有让蜂蜜自动变纯，也可能有人伪造印章，但它让两种卖家承担承诺的成本不同。后来集市又增加统一检验，防止只靠纸面声誉。
冬天第一场霜后，老蜂农带着秤回到集市。他先检查自己卖出的旧契纸，才摆上新罐。
explanationParagraphs: Signaling occurs when a better-informed party takes an observable action to communicate hidden qualities. A signal is credible when different types face different costs or incentives in sustaining it, making imitation unattractive to lower-quality types. Signals change beliefs rather than guarantee truth and may be copied, corrupted, or wasteful, so verification and institutional support often remain necessary.
explanationParagraphsZh: 信号传递发生在信息较多的一方采取可观察行动，以传达隐藏特征。信号可信通常因为不同类型承担它的成本或持续激励不同，使低质量者难以模仿。信号只改变他人信念，不保证真相，也可能被复制、腐化或造成浪费，因此常需检验与制度支持。

articles.title: The Regular Guest Who Stayed One Night
articles.summary: An innkeeper gives the best room to a high-paying visitor and leaves a monthly traveller beneath a leaking roof.
articles.summaryZh: 旅店老板把最好房间留给一次付清高价的人，却让一名每月经过的客人睡在漏雨处。
storyParagraphs: A mountain-pass inn had one good room with a stove. On a rainy night, a jeweller offered triple the usual price, so the owner gave it to him and placed a herb carrier in a leaking side room. The jeweller left the next morning and never passed that way again.

The carrier had stayed two nights each month and often brought other drivers. After that visit, he moved to another inn, and the convoy followed. The owner saw only the extra coins from one night, not future rooms, meals, and referrals, nor the continuing cost of serving those guests.

The owner began considering return frequency, contribution per visit, likely duration, and service cost together. Some high-paying guests came only once. Some frequent low-paying guests required arrangements that cost more than they brought. The estimates were uncertain and could change with the way the inn treated people.

When the inn next filled, the owner did not use the figures as a moral ranking. Urgent needs still mattered. He used expected relationship value when deciding how to maintain rooms, offer return benefits, and spend on attracting guests.
When the carrier passed again, the owner had repaired the leaking room. After recording one night's payment, he also entered the name on a future booking page.
storyParagraphsZh: 山口旅店只有一间带火炉的好房。雨夜里，一名珠宝商愿意付三倍房钱，老板便把房间给了他，让常送药材的车夫住进漏雨小屋。珠宝商第二天离开，再也没有经过山口。
车夫过去每月住两晚，还常带来同行。那次以后，他改去另一家旅店，跟着他的车队也一并离开。老板只看见当晚多收的银币，没有看见未来许多次住宿、饭食和介绍，也没有计算长期服务他们所需的成本。
老板开始把客人的回访频率、每次贡献、可能留下多久以及额外服务记在一起。他发现有些高价客只来一次，有些低价客虽常来，却需要超过收入的特殊安排。估计并非永远准确，也会因旅店怎样待人而改变。
后来又遇到满房，老板没有按账表给人排道德高低。他仍照顾紧急需要，只把长期关系的预期价值用于决定房间维护、回访优惠和接客投入。
车夫再次经过时，老板先修好了漏雨小屋。登记完一晚房钱后，他在未来月份的预订页上也留下了名字。
explanationParagraphs: Customer lifetime value estimates the present value of expected future contribution from a customer relationship, considering revenue, margin, retention, time, acquisition, and service cost. It can guide resource allocation but remains uncertain and partly shaped by the firm's own treatment of customers. It should not become a moral ranking and requires privacy, fairness, and sensitivity checks.
explanationParagraphsZh: 客户终身价值估计一段客户关系预期未来贡献的现值，通常考虑收入、利润、留存、时间以及获客和服务成本。它能支持资源配置，却是不确定且会受企业行为影响的模型，不应成为人的道德排名，并需要隐私、公平与敏感性检查。

articles.title: A Red Ribbon on Every Letter
articles.summary: The mailroom marks urgent letters with red ribbon; within three days, every sender learns how to reach the front.
articles.summaryZh: 信房规定急件系红带，三天后，所有寄件人都学会了怎样让自己的事排在最前面。
storyParagraphs: The civic mailroom could process only fifty letters a day. Its manager ordered urgent items tied with red ribbon and ordinary mail placed behind. At first, fire reports, broken bridges, and missing-person notices moved quickly. Soon merchants tied red ribbon to overdue invoices, officials used it for banquet seating, and even a request to repair a window was marked urgent to avoid the queue.

The table became entirely red. Sorters judged by whoever wrote most dramatically. A levee seepage report without ribbon sank to the bottom. Its sender was not skilled at exaggeration and merely listed the water marks. By the time the letter was opened, the crack had grown.

The manager redesigned the first sorting pass. Staff considered how quickly delay could worsen the problem, the severity of consequences, source credibility, reversibility, and who could act. Red ribbon remained a clue but no longer controlled rank. Uncertain reports with potentially serious safety effects went first to someone able to check them.

Older letters automatically moved upward each day, and routing mistakes returned to the mailroom as feedback. The banquet letter was downgraded; the seepage report became a training case. Senders still tried to compete for attention, and the rules required checks for quiet people being overlooked.
When another water-mark sketch arrived without ribbon, the sorter checked its date and location and placed it in the first delivery bag of the day.
storyParagraphsZh: 城务信房每天只能处理五十封信。主管规定，急件系红带，普通信排后。起初火警、断桥和失踪通报很快送达。没过几天，商人给催款信系红带，官员给宴会座次系红带，连请求修窗的人也怕排队而系上红带。
桌面很快一片红。分信员只能看谁写得最吓人，一封没有红带的堤坝渗水报告被压在底部。寄信的守堤人不擅长夸大，只写了水痕位置。等信被打开，裂缝已经扩大。
主管重做第一轮分类：先看若不处理会多快恶化、后果多重、信息是否可信、能否挽回以及由谁负责。红带仍作为线索，却不能单独决定顺序。不确定但可能严重的安全信会先转给能核查的人。
队列里的旧信每天自动上移，分错的结果会反馈给信房。宴会信被降级，渗水报告则成为训练样例。寄件人仍会尝试争先，规则也需要持续检查是否让安静的人更难被看见。
第二次收到无红带的水痕图时，分信员先看图上的日期和位置，随后把它放进了当天第一只送件袋。
explanationParagraphs: Information triage rapidly and provisionally prioritises and routes incoming information when processing capacity is limited. Urgency, severity, credibility, reversibility, and responsibility may all matter. Triage is not final truth judgement; it needs escalation, review, queue ageing, feedback, and fairness checks to resist label manipulation and the neglect of quiet risks.
explanationParagraphsZh: 信息分诊是在处理能力有限时，对进入信息作快速、暂时的优先分类和路由。紧迫性、严重性、可信度、可逆性与责任归属都可能相关。分诊不是最终真相判断，还需要升级、复查、队列老化、反馈和公平检查，以防标签操纵或安静风险被漏掉。

articles.title: Three Orders for One Bridge
articles.summary: Both ends of a bridge follow a correct drawing and still meet half a metre apart over the river.
articles.summaryZh: 桥梁两端各按一张正确图纸施工，合到河心时却相差了半丈。
storyParagraphs: After bridge construction began, the designer issued Drawing One. She then corrected a water-level error and issued Drawing Two. A third draft, not yet approved by the city, was copied by an assistant. All three looked official, with only a small number in one corner.

The eastern foreman received Drawing Two. The western foreman used the third draft. The stone yard still cut from Drawing One. Everyone believed their copy was newest. When the decks reached midstream, their heights differed by half a metre and the prepared stone no longer fitted.

The designer could not merely say 'always use the latest', because the newest document was an unapproved draft, while the oldest still needed to remain for investigation. The project introduced unique identifiers, status, and effective dates. Approved drawings came from one register, recipients confirmed receipt, and obsolete copies were stamped rather than destroyed.
The next change record named the beam affected, the reason, approver, and start time. The stone yard and both banks received the same notice and returned their working copies.
Before joining the bridge, the two foremen spread their drawings at midstream. Only after number, approval mark, and effective date matched did they lower the final deck board.
storyParagraphsZh: 新桥开工后，设计师先发出一号图。发现水位计算有误，她又修改桥墩高度，发出二号图；随后市政厅尚未批准的三号草稿也被一名助手拿去复印。三份图都印得清楚，只在角落有很小的编号。
东岸工头收到二号图，西岸工头拿到三号草稿，仓库仍按一号图切石。每个人都相信自己手里的副本最新。桥面伸到河心时，两边高度相差半丈，石料也已无法直接使用。
设计师不能只喊“以后都用最新版”，因为三号虽较新却未获批准，一号虽旧仍需要留作追查。工程队建立唯一图号、状态和生效日期；批准图从中央登记处发出，领取人确认收讫，旧图盖上废止印但不销毁。
下一次修改时，变更记录清楚写出哪根梁、为何改变、谁批准以及从何时执行。仓库、东西岸都收到同一份通知，并交回现场工作副本。
桥合龙前，两个工头把图纸摊在河心。编号、批准章和生效日期全部相同，他们才放下最后一块桥板。
explanationParagraphs: Record version control identifies versions, status, and authority; manages distribution, approval, effective dates, and withdrawal; and preserves a traceable history of change. The newest copy may still be a draft, while an old version may be retained for audit or recovery. Reliable control also uses unique identifiers, permissions, receipt confirmation, change logs, and an authoritative source.
explanationParagraphsZh: 记录版本控制识别版本、状态与权威，管理分发、批准、生效和废止，并保留可追踪的变更历史。最新副本可能仍是草稿，旧版也可能需供审计或回退。可靠控制还包括唯一标识、权限、收讫确认、变更日志和权威来源。

articles.title: The Office with No Time to Work
articles.titleZh: 没有时间工作的办公室
articles.summary: To prevent any department being surprised, a coordinator invites everyone to every meeting until no one can complete the decisions.
articles.summaryZh: 为了不让任何部门意外，协调员把所有人请进每场会议，直到没人有时间完成会议里的决定。
storyParagraphs: The city works office managed roads, drains, trees, and markets. Afraid that one decision might affect someone else, new coordinator Luyi required all twelve departments to attend every change. Replacing a road sign needed a meeting; moving one tree waited for every reply.

At first, omissions fell. Then meetings consumed mornings and confirmation messages consumed afternoons. Most people had an interest in only one or two items but sat through the whole discussion. Decisions with genuine interdependence disappeared in the noise. One drain improvement waited three weeks until the rainy season arrived.

Luyi mapped a month of decisions and identified work that truly shared place, time, or resources. Drainage and roads needed joint decisions. The tree office joined only within excavation areas. Markets received notice through one representative. Small changes inside agreed standards proceeded directly; only exceptions escalated.

Communication did not disappear. Cross-department projects used one shared map and fixed review days, and each task named its decision owner. When tree roots unexpectedly met an old pipe, the group revised the conditions requiring escalation.
The next Tuesday morning, only four of the twelve meeting chairs were occupied. For the first time, people were working at all the other desks at once.
storyParagraphsZh: 城建办公室负责道路、排水、树木和市集。新协调员陆宜害怕一个决定影响别人，便要求每次改动都让十二个部门参加。修一块路牌要开会，移动一棵树也要等待所有人回复。
起初，遗漏确实减少。后来会议占满上午，确认邮件占满下午。多数人只与其中一两项有关，却必须听完整场；真正相互依赖的决定反而被淹没。一个排水改造等了三周，雨季已经到来。
陆宜把近月决定画在墙上，找出哪些工作真正共享地点、时间或资源。排水与道路需要共同决定，树木只在挖掘范围内参与，市集则由一名代表接收通知。小改动按既定标准直接执行，超出边界才升级。
会议减少后，并非所有沟通都消失。跨部门项目使用同一张图和固定检查日，决策人也清楚写在任务旁。一次树根意外碰到旧管线，团队便调整了需要升级的条件。
下一个星期二上午，十二把会议椅只坐了四个人。其余桌上第一次同时有人在工作。
explanationParagraphs: Coordination cost is the time, attention, communication, negotiation, monitoring, and delay required to align interdependent activity. Coordination prevents incompatibility but grows with connections, ambiguity, and uncertainty. Clear boundaries, decision rights, standards, shared information, selective participation, and suitable rhythms balance compatibility against burden.
explanationParagraphsZh: 协调成本是让相互依赖活动一致所需的时间、注意、沟通、协商、监督和等待。协调能防止冲突，却会随连接、含混和不确定增加。清楚边界、决策权、标准、共享信息、选择性参与和合适节奏，可以在兼容性与负担之间取得平衡。

articles.title: The Fruit Shop with the Fullest Shelves
articles.summary: A fruit seller fills every shelf to look prosperous while spoiled produce leaves through the back door each day.
articles.summaryZh: 水果店老板把货架塞得最满，顾客称赞它富足，后门却每天运出腐烂的果子。
storyParagraphs: Fruit seller Yao Feng loved full shelves. At every delivery, he bought a month's supply, believing empty space would make customers doubt the business. The shop looked abundant, but soft fruit left through the rear door each day, while storage and cooling costs rose.

After hearing that faster sales were better, he suddenly cut inventory to one day. Rain blocked the road in the second week. Apples and pears sold out before noon, and many customers left empty-handed. Waste had fallen, but lost sales and trust did not appear in the spoiled-fruit basket.

Yao Feng began examining how much each variety sold over time, how long it remained, its shelf life, delivery route, and festival demand. Berries arrived often in small amounts. Durable apples held a larger reserve. Before rainy weeks, he ordered earlier.

The shelves were no longer always full or often empty. Slow products were reduced, while high-margin varieties that customers expected remained even when they moved more slowly. The number made sense only beside the product and service goal.
At month's end, Yao Feng counted the final apple crate and wrote the next delivery date on the order board instead of 'more is better'.
storyParagraphsZh: 果商姚丰喜欢满货架。每逢进货，他总买够一个月，觉得空位会让顾客怀疑生意不好。店面看起来丰盛，后门却每天抬出软烂水果，仓租和冷藏费也越来越高。
他听说货卖得越快越好，便突然把库存降到一天。第二周道路被雨阻断，苹果和梨在中午前售罄，许多顾客空手离开。腐烂少了，失去的销售和信任却没有写在废果筐里。
姚丰开始按品种查看一段时间内卖出多少、平均留在店里多久，又考虑保鲜期、补货路程和节庆需求。浆果少量多进，耐放的苹果保留更高安全量，雨季前则提前备货。
货架不再永远满，也不再常常空。某些慢销品被缩减，利润高且顾客常找的品种则即使周转稍慢也继续保留。数字只有放进商品和服务目标里才有意义。
月底，姚丰清点最后一筐苹果，在进货木牌上写下下一次到货日，而不是再写“越多越好”。
explanationParagraphs: Inventory turnover measures how quickly average inventory is sold or used and must be interpreted with shelf life, season, lead time, margin, and service goals. Low turnover may indicate excess, obsolescence, and holding cost; extremely high turnover may signal stockouts, underinvestment, and lost sales. The aim is not simply the highest value.
explanationParagraphsZh: 库存周转衡量平均库存被售出或使用的速度，需结合保质期、季节、补货时间、利润和服务目标解释。周转过低可能表示积压、过时和持有成本；过高也可能意味着缺货、投入不足和流失销售。目标不是单纯追求最大数值。

articles.title: The Rain That Grew Upstream
articles.summary: A town sells only a few dozen extra umbrellas while the mountain frame workshop prepares for a flood of orders.
articles.summaryZh: 小镇只多卖了几十把雨伞，山上的伞骨工坊却以为洪水般的订单已经来了。
storyParagraphs: Spring rain arrived two days early, and the town umbrella shop sold thirty more umbrellas than usual. Fearing continued rain and a shortage at the wholesaler, the owner raised her replenishment order from one hundred to one hundred and fifty. The order moved more than customer sales had.

The wholesaler could not see daily purchases, only the shop's sudden increase. Expecting other towns to compete for stock and needing to fill a cart for each shipment, he ordered two hundred and fifty umbrellas from the warehouse. The warehouse added its own reserve and requested four hundred frame sets from the mountain workshop.

The workshop hired night labour, bought bamboo, and stopped other products. The rain ended quickly; the shop's total increase remained the original thirty umbrellas. Stock accumulated at every stage, and the following month everyone cancelled orders together. A small shower downstream became first a production surge and then a collapse upstream.

The next year, shops shared actual sales and stock with the wholesaler. Orders became smaller and more frequent, and transport no longer waited for a full cart. Promotion and shortage-allocation rules were stated in advance, reducing the need to exaggerate orders to secure supply.
When rain returned, the mountain workshop still increased output. Its owner checked the sales sheet, added one shift, and did not ring the village bell for night work.
storyParagraphsZh: 春雨比往年早了两天，镇上伞店多卖出三十把伞。店主担心继续下雨，也怕批发商缺货，便把补货量从一百提高到一百五十。订单看起来比顾客实际增加得更多。
批发商看不见每日销售，只看见伞店突然加单。他猜其他镇也将抢货，又因每次运输必须装满一车，便向仓库订了两百五十把。仓库再加上安全余量，向山上工坊要四百套伞骨。
工坊连夜招人、买竹、停掉其他产品。雨却很快结束，伞店卖出的增量只有最初那三十把。各层库存随后一起积压，下一月又同时取消订单。下游一场小雨，传到山上变成先猛增、再骤停的生产。
第二年，伞店把实际销量与库存直接共享给批发商，订货改为小批多次，运输也不再必须凑整车。促销和缺货时的分配规则提前说清，没人需要靠夸大订单争抢份额。
下一场雨来时，山上仍增加了产量。工坊主看着销量表，只添了一班工，没有再敲响全村的夜工钟。
explanationParagraphs: The bullwhip effect occurs when small changes in final demand become amplified upstream through local forecasting, order batching, lead times, promotions, and strategic ordering under shortage. Sharing point-of-sale demand, shortening lead times, stabilising prices, ordering in smaller batches, and coordinating allocation can reduce amplification, though not remove all variability.
explanationParagraphsZh: 牛鞭效应是终端需求的小幅变化沿供应链向上游传递时，被预测更新、批量订货、提前期、促销、限量博弈等局部决定逐级放大。共享真实销售、缩短提前期、稳定价格、小批补货和协调规则可以缓解，但不能消除所有波动。

articles.title: Three Fares on the Same Tide
articles.titleZh: 同一班潮水的三种船票
articles.summary: Three passengers cross the same water in the same boat after paying different fares.
articles.summaryZh: 三名乘客坐上同一条船、经过同一片水，却为船票付了不同的钱。
storyParagraphs: The tide ferry sailed once each day when the water allowed. Every seat and crossing was the same, but the clerk sold three fares: the lowest for purchase seven days ahead, the highest for a ticket changeable on the day, and another low fare for island residents.

A visiting merchant discovered that the resident beside him had paid half as much and became angry. The owner explained that advance tickets revealed whether a sailing was worthwhile; expensive flexible tickets served people who needed to change plans; resident fares kept frequent travel accessible to people with lower incomes. Passengers valued time and flexibility differently.

The system filled boats in quiet months but was not always fair. The clerk found that older passengers unable to use advance booking often paid the costly same-day fare. Traders also resold cheap tickets. The ferry added in-person advance purchase and attached names to discounted tickets to limit resale.

The three prices were not fully explained by the additional cost of carrying each person. They relied on purchase timing, status, and contract terms. This could widen access while also charging more to urgent travellers, so accessibility and power required continued review.
Before departure, the clerk tore three colours of ticket stub and placed them in the same wooden box.
storyParagraphsZh: 潮汐渡船每天只在水位合适时开一班。船上座位相同，渡程也相同，售票员却卖三种票：提前七日购买最便宜，当天可退改的最贵，岛上常住者另有低价。
外地商人发现邻座岛民只付自己一半，十分生气。船主解释，提前票让他更早知道是否值得开船；高价票卖给必须保留改期选择的人；居民票则让收入较低、必须经常往返的人能够使用渡船。每位乘客对时间和灵活性的需要不同。
这种做法让淡季也能坐满，却不总是公平。售票员后来发现，有些不会使用预售柜台的老人只能买高价当天票；商人也会替别人转卖便宜票。船主增加线下预订，并让低价票实名，避免转售破坏安排。
三种价格并非由运送某位乘客的额外成本完全造成，而建立在购买时机、身份和条款差异上。它既能扩大使用，也能从急需者身上收取更多，因而需要持续检查可及性和权力。
开船前，售票员撕下三种颜色的票根，把它们放进同一个木盒。
explanationParagraphs: Price discrimination charges different effective prices for comparable goods or services for reasons not fully explained by cost, using group, timing, quantity, willingness to pay, or self-selected terms. It generally requires market power and limits on resale. It may expand access or extract more surplus and create unfairness, and should be distinguished from cost-based pricing.
explanationParagraphsZh: 价格歧视是在成本差异不足以解释时，对可比商品或服务按群体、时机、数量、支付意愿或自选条款收取不同有效价格。它通常需要市场力量和限制转售。结果可能扩大服务，也可能抽取更多剩余或造成不公，需与成本定价区分。

articles.title: The Bench That Repaired More Than Machines
articles.summary: The textile mill's real repair lessons happen on an oil-darkened bench during lunch rather than inside its manuals.
articles.summaryZh: 纺织厂真正的维修课不在手册里，而在午休时总被油污弄黑的那张长凳上。
storyParagraphs: Every new repairer at the textile mill received a thick manual. Adian could recite gear numbers, but when a machine made what workers called a 'wet wood sound', he did not know where to look. At lunch, experienced repairers sat on a yard bench and told stories of last year's vibrations or the oil smell that preceded an overheated bearing.

At first, Adian only fetched tools and barely understood their shorthand. Months later, he joined simple inspections and learned to tell a failure as a story others could question. The older workers did not merely give answers; they asked him to connect sound, temperature, and changes in the cloth.

One day, a new machine repeatedly snapped thread. The bench group blamed an over-tight tension wheel from past experience, but repeated adjustments failed. Adian suggested consulting another mill and invited the manufacturer's technician. The new fibre was expanding under heat; familiar language had nearly carried everyone toward the same mistake.

The bench continued preserving experience but added failure records, newcomer questions, and outside contacts. Adian moved from listener to repairer and began giving the next newcomer low-risk tasks rather than leaving them at the edge.
Years later, the bench received new boards. The workers kept the oldest oil-stained plank and fixed it to the repair-room wall.
storyParagraphsZh: 纺织厂给新维修工每人一本厚手册。阿典背得出齿轮型号，却遇到机器发出“湿木声”时不知道该查哪里。午休时，老维修工总坐在后院长凳上，说起某台机器去年怎样抖、哪种油味意味着轴承过热。
阿典起初只替他们拿工具，听不懂那些简称。几个月后，他能参与简单检查，也学会把一次故障讲成别人可以接着追问的故事。老工人不只传答案，还会让他指出声响、温度和布面变化之间的关系。
一天，新机型反复断线。长凳上的人凭旧经验认定张力轮太紧，调整数次都无效。阿典提出查看外厂资料，并请制造商技师参加一次讨论。问题最后来自新材料遇热伸长，旧行话差点把所有人带向同一错误。
此后，长凳仍然保存经验，却增加故障记录、新人提问和外部联系。阿典从旁听者变成能修机器的人，也开始负责让下一位新人先做低风险工作，而不是只坐在一旁。
多年后，长凳换了木板。大家保留了最旧那块沾油的板，钉在维修间墙上。
explanationParagraphs: A community of practice is a group sharing a domain who develop knowledge and identity through sustained participation in common activity, relationships, tools, language, and problem-solving. Learning includes movement from limited toward fuller participation. Such communities transmit tacit judgement but can exclude newcomers or reproduce error, making access, questioning, records, and outside links important.
explanationParagraphsZh: 实践共同体是一群共享领域的人，通过持续参与共同活动、关系、工具、语言和问题解决来发展知识与身份。学习包括从有限参与走向更充分参与。共同体能传递默会判断，也可能排斥新人或复制错误，因此需要开放进入、质疑、记录和外部联系。

articles.title: The Fire Everyone Was Responsible For
articles.summary: A theatre sign says fire safety belongs to everyone; when smoke appears, each person assumes someone else is ringing the bell.
articles.summaryZh: 剧院墙上写着“消防人人有责”，烟冒出来时，每个人都以为别人正在敲钟。
storyParagraphs: A sign in the riverside theatre said FIRE SAFETY IS EVERYONE'S RESPONSIBILITY. The manager considered that clear enough and never assigned who rang the alarm, led the audience, or shut the lamp oil. When scenery began smoking backstage, three people ran to find him and no one first rang the bell.

Two others both fetched water and collided on the narrow stairs. The doorkeeper assumed the stage manager had opened the side exits; the stage manager assumed the doorkeeper was doing it. The fire was contained with little damage, but confusion crowded the audience at the main entrance.

The theatre did not replace the sign with a longer slogan. The first person seeing smoke rang the bell. The stage manager stopped the performance and led backstage action. The doorkeeper opened exits and checked areas. The lamp keeper shut the oil line. Each duty named a backup and a handover signal.

Clear roles did not forbid help. If the water carrier became trapped, the nearest person still took over, and anyone seeing a new danger could act without waiting for the highest rank. Drills exposed a gap between exit checks and backstage reports, so the arrangement changed.
At the second smoke drill, the first bell sent four people in four directions. No one ran to the manager to ask what to do.
storyParagraphsZh: 河岸剧院的墙上写着“消防人人有责”。经理认为这句话足够清楚，从未规定谁敲警钟、谁带观众离场、谁关灯油。一次后台布景冒烟，三个人同时跑去找经理，却没有人先敲钟。
另有两人各自去提水，撞在狭窄楼梯上；门房以为舞台主管已经开侧门，舞台主管又以为门房在做。火最终被扑灭，损失不大，混乱却让观众在正门挤成一团。
事后，剧院没有把责任缩成一句更长的标语。第一个发现烟的人立即敲钟；舞台主管决定是否停演并指挥后台；门房打开出口、清点区域；灯工关闭油路。每项还指定替补和交接信号。
清楚分工并不禁止互相帮助。若负责提水的人被困，最近者仍应接手；发现新危险也无需等职位最高的人批准。大家通过演练找出出口清点与后台报告之间的空隙，再修改安排。
第二次演练起烟时，第一声钟响后，四个人朝四个不同方向跑去，没有一个人去找经理问该做什么。
explanationParagraphs: Role clarity is shared understanding of a role's purpose, responsibilities, authority, priorities, interfaces, and expected results. It reduces duplication, gaps, and delay without requiring rigidity; judgement, backup, adaptation, and mutual help remain necessary. Conflicting expectations from different sources must be resolved rather than merely described.
explanationParagraphsZh: 角色清晰度是成员对角色目的、责任、权力、优先级、接口和预期结果的共同理解，可减少重复、缺口与等待。清晰不等于僵硬；仍需判断、替补、适应和互助。若不同来源提出不相容期待，还必须解决角色冲突。

articles.title: The Recipe That Obeyed Only Old Flour
articles.summary: A baker can perform an inherited recipe with closed eyes until a new wheat harvest turns every dough into paste.
articles.summaryZh: 面包师能闭眼完成祖传配方，新收的小麦却让每一团面都变成了稀泥。
storyParagraphs: Baker Gu Qi had made the same loaf for twenty years. He never missed the amount of water, number of kneads, or moment for the oven, even with his eyes closed. The workshop supplied the town through this speed, and apprentices only had to follow the recipe.

After floods reduced the old harvest, the mill delivered wheat from the northern slope. Gu Qi added the usual water. The dough clung to the table and the loaves emerged flat and wet. He blamed defective flour and repeated the same failure for three batches.

Apprentice Xiaoning weighed both flours, varied the water, and observed absorption and formation time. The new wheat could make bread, but its protein and moisture differed. She tested small portions and adjusted kneading and fermentation instead of covering the problem with random extra flour.

Gu Qi first complained that testing was slow. As town orders ran short, he kept the familiar process for remaining old wheat and reserved one small table for trials on each new batch. Within days, the new recipe stabilised and speed gradually returned.
When the next flour cart arrived, Gu Qi did not immediately recite the water quantity. He rubbed a handful between his fingers and left one small bowl for a test dough.
storyParagraphsZh: 面包师顾齐做同一种面包二十年。几勺水、揉多少下、何时进炉，他闭着眼也不会错。作坊靠这种速度供应全镇，学徒只需照配方执行。
洪水过后，旧麦田歉收，磨坊送来北坡新麦。顾齐仍按原量加水，面团却黏在桌上，烤出的面包扁而湿。他责怪面粉不合格，又连续做了三批同样的失败品。
学徒小宁把两种面粉分别称量，加不同水量，观察吸水和成团时间。新麦不是不能做面包，只是蛋白和含水不同。她先做小份试验，再调整揉制与发酵，而不是随意多撒面粉遮住问题。
顾齐起初嫌试验太慢。镇上订单将断时，他同意保留熟悉流程处理旧麦，同时让一张小桌专门测试新批次。几天后，新配方稳定下来，速度也逐渐恢复。
下一车面粉到坊时，顾齐没有立刻背出水量。他先抓起一把面粉捻了捻，留出一小碗做试团。
explanationParagraphs: Adaptive expertise combines efficient, accurate performance in familiar settings with conceptual understanding, flexible adjustment, and responsible experimentation in unfamiliar ones. It requires strong routines and the ability to recognise when their assumptions fail. Varied cases, prediction, feedback, and reflection support it; unconstrained improvisation does not.
explanationParagraphsZh: 适应性专长结合熟悉情境中的高效准确与陌生情境中的概念理解、灵活调整和负责任试验。它要求扎实惯例，也要求识别惯例假设何时失效。多样案例、预测、反馈与反思有助于形成这种能力，而非无约束即兴。
